heading.title: Rules in cases of Intestates other than Parsis

article.title: Rules of distribution.
article.content: The rules for the distribution of the intestate’s property (after deducting the widow’s share, if he has left a widow) amongst his lineal descendants shall be those contained in sections 37 to 40.
article.html:
36Rules of distribution.

Section 36 · Part V · Chapter II · page 23 of the Act

The rules for the distribution of the intestate’s property (after deducting the widow’s share, if he has left a widow) amongst his lineal descendants shall be those contained in sections 37 to 40.
